business_problem: Electronics retailer Euronics Hungary wanted to optimize its SAP workloads to meet customer demand seamlessly.
solution_summary: Electronics retailer Euronics Hungary wanted to optimize its SAP workloads to meet customer demand seamlessly. To do so, the company, which operates an ecommerce website and over 60 physical stores, migrated its critical workloads to Amazon Web Services (AWS), helping improve the reliability, scalability, and security of its infrastructure.

solution_components.name: Amazon EC2
solution_components.role: Provides elastic compute capacity for application, analytics, and infrastructure workloads.

solution_components.name: AWS Security Hub
solution_components.role: Aggregates and automates cloud security findings and best-practice checks.

solution_components.name: Amazon CloudWatch
solution_components.role: Monitors application, infrastructure, and operational health signals.
